objective: Sincronizador | Diagnostico global R35 | Leer payloads de los ultimos jobs ISCAM/detail y comercial-range fallidos para identificar error_code y fecha exactos. Solo lectura.

queries.name: failed_iscam_payloads
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 12 ResyncLogID, TipoSync, UnidadCodigo, Estado, Mensaje, JSON_QUERY(Payload,'$.failed_dates') AS failed_dates, JSON_QUERY(Payload,'$.results') AS results FROM dbo.Sistema_Sync_ResyncLog WHERE TipoSync='iscam_detail_batch' AND Estado IN ('JOB_FAILED','JOB_PARTIAL','JOB_STALE') ORDER BY ResyncLogID DESC

queries.name: failed_range_payloads
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 8 ResyncLogID, TipoSync, UnidadCodigo, Estado, Mensaje, JSON_QUERY(Payload,'$.steps') AS steps FROM dbo.Sistema_Sync_ResyncLog WHERE TipoSync='comercial_range_batch' AND Estado IN ('JOB_PARTIAL','JOB_FAILED','JOB_STALE') ORDER BY ResyncLogID DESC
